MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The self drilling screws with washers fit my recent fastening work and add a useful option alongside my rivets, rivet nuts, and screw assortments.",
    "The wire brushes fit cleaning and preparing metal before assembly or bonding, while the cutting wheels fit my recent metalworking purchases, provided they fit my grinder.",
    "The metric hex head bolts could complement my smaller socket head fasteners for heavier assemblies."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The electrical leads and clamp meter relate broadly to repair work, but my inspection camera and measuring tools do not mean I currently need electrical troubleshooting equipment.",
    "I have no current need for radiation monitoring, and the mixed detector and test lead title leaves me unsure what the item actually is.",
    "Repair tape and acrylic are potentially useful, but large tape bundles and sheets without a specific project or required dimensions are not things I would choose now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning inspection and measuring tools seems to have been taken as interest in other instruments, even when they serve very different tasks.",
    "My adhesive purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest bulk duct tape, although mounting strips and double sided tape serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases repeatedly involve fastening and fabrication, so tools and supplies that support those jobs matter more than general workshop relevance.",
    "Compatibility matters: the recommended cutting wheels are 4.5 inches, while my previous wheels were 5 inches.",
    "Frequent purchases do not mean I need large quantities of every supply; I still need a concrete use for another tape bundle or a particular size of acrylic sheet."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my workshop interests but matched my current needs best when they supported fastening, metal preparation, and fabrication."
}
